sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea and vomiting, \vith great weak-
iKss. Griping pains in bowels.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Watery, copious, forceful. Squirting diar-
rheva; frothy, olive 'green, with cutting in abdomen.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs,
knees, toes, and instep. Gouty pain in great toes. Pain
extends down extremities; pain in hip-joints with diar-
rhoea. Arthritic nodules.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Smarts, stings, and burns. Dropsical. Urti-
caria from suppressed intermittent. Skin, firaiige color.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chill comes on with much yaioniiig and
stretching, lasting all through chill. Pain in extremities,
darting into fingers and toes. Chills and fever, with
spurting diarrhoea.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text: Worse, from exposure on damp ground.
